# jidonglab
> Personal site and portfolio of jidonglab — a developer working on small AI-adjacent products. The site collects build logs, project notes, and occasional articles in Korean and English.

jidonglab.com is the personal site of jidonglab. It serves as a portfolio, a public archive of build logs, and an index of side projects.

## Site Structure
- Homepage: https://jidonglab.com
- Blog: https://jidonglab.com/blog — Articles and notes
- AI News: https://jidonglab.com/ai-news — AI industry news summaries
- Build Logs: https://jidonglab.com/posts — Project build logs
- Projects: https://jidonglab.com/projects — Project index
- About: https://jidonglab.com/about

## Content Categories
- Build logs from in-progress projects
- Short technical notes and tips
- AI news summaries
- Project pages with links and descriptions

## Projects (selected)
- AgentCrow
- ContextZip
- LLMMixer
- FortuneLab
- spoonai

## Key Facts
- Author: jidonglab
- Languages: Korean, English
- Tech stack: Astro, Cloudflare Pages
- External profiles: DEV.to (jee599), GitHub (jee599)
